offers.title: Extra 7% off in the 7-7-7 sale
offers.terms: Book by Oct 20, 2026. Supplier terms apply.
offers.why: Adults-only all-inclusive: meals, drinks and activities are covered, so there's little to plan once you arrive. Need an accessible room? Several Sandals resorts have roll-in showers, but only a few rooms each, so ask early.

offers.title: Explora Journeys festive sailings, up to 30% off
offers.terms: Reserve by Oct 27, 2026 for savings of up to 30% and a reduced 10% deposit on Festive Journeys (Caribbean and Mediterranean). Supplier terms apply.
offers.why: A luxury way to spend the holidays with family and friends without the work of hosting. Worth a look if you want a special celebration trip.

offers.title: FunPacks add-on bundles
offers.terms: Purchase by Oct 30, 2026, for sailings Oct 31, 2026 through Dec 31, 2027.
offers.why: Settling add-ons before you sail makes the family budget easier and means fewer decisions on board.

offers.title: Fall Sale: 75% off the 2nd guest, 3rd-5th free
offers.terms: Book Sept 22 – Nov 5, 2026, for select sailings Sept 22, 2026 – May 10, 2029. 75% off 2nd guest on non-refundable deposit rates, 50% off on refundable deposit rates; free 3rd/4th/5th guest fares on select sailings. Supplier terms apply.
offers.why: If you're sailing as a couple, the second guest's fare drops a lot. If you're bringing the whole family, 3rd, 4th and 5th guests in the same stateroom sail free, which makes a multi-generational trip much easier to budget.

offers.title: Princess Fall Savings Sale
offers.terms: Runs through Nov 5, 2026, on select cruises and new bookings only; deposit required. Supplier terms apply.
offers.why: A good moment to lock in a Princess sailing for next year while the sale is on. Ask me which dates and ships fit your group.

offers.title: Early Booking Bonus on 2028–29 sailings
offers.why: New itineraries have the widest choice of cabins on opening day, including connecting cabins for families and the few accessible ones.

offers.title: Princess Hotels Fall & Winter Sale, up to 42% off

offers.why: Beach resort getaways in Punta Cana and Riviera Maya at a lower rate for the cooler months. Good for families and couples who want sun without the long flight.
